scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix ../tsn-sdk install && npm --prefix ../tsn-sdk run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='../tsn-sdk'; const dest='node_modules/@trustlink/tsn-sdk'; let isSame=false; try { if (fs.realpathSync(src) === fs.realpathSync(dest)) isSame=true; } catch(e){} if (!isSame) { fs.mkdirSync(dest + '/dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src + '/dist', dest + '/dist', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src + '/package.json', dest + '/package.json'); }"
